newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE mark futures most traded.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE mark futures most traded.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed slightly firmer against the dollar on Tuesday in what dealers said was a quiet day on the interbank forex market.
The unit closed 20 pips below the central bank bid at 155.17/22 to the dollar, compared with its opening of 155.28.
"After some forint selling in the morning things became very quiet later," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.

The mark was the most popular currency on the currency futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange, rising in price for November and June while the dollar fell for four contracts. -- Budapest newsroom ++361 327 4040.
